description: The bar chart illustrates the number of "Factual Errors" across four different categories, comparing three distinct methods within each category. The horizontal axis contains the categories, with three of the four groups explicitly labeled as "2WikiMQA", "MuSiQue", and "IIRC" from left to right, while the first group's label is not visible in the crop. The vertical axis represents the numerical value, scaled linearly from 5 to 30 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5; it lacks a specific axis title, though a text box reading "Factual Errors" is positioned in the upper left. The chart features grouped bars, with each category containing a cluster of three bars arranged side-by-side. According to the visible portions of the legend, the first bar in each group is colored orange with a grid pattern representing "NoR QA", the second is red with a dotted pattern representing "OneR QA", and the third is dark blue with diagonal stripes, though its corresponding legend label is cut off. Every bar is visually emphasized with these distinct geometric fill patterns and is annotated with its exact numerical value at the top. In the first, unlabeled category, the values are 15 (orange), 10 (red), and 5 (blue), with 5 being the shortest bar in the entire chart. For "2WikiMQA", the values are 29 (orange, the tallest bar in the chart), 23 (red), and 14 (blue). In the "MuSiQue" category, the bars measure 28 (orange), 27 (red), and 23 (blue). Finally, the "IIRC" category shows values of 15 (orange), 14 (red), and 11 (blue). Within every grouped category, the bars are consistently sorted in descending order of height from left to right, and the entire chart image is rendered at a tilted angle.
